input_context.user_message: Help me with subjects for my course, but I have not given you much information.

ui.purpose: Identify the exact target tertiary course and institution to evaluate official prerequisites and subject recommendations.
ui.prompt: Which specific course and university or college do you want to check subjects for?

derived_signals.signal: Course-specific subject advice requested without a target course or institution.
derived_signals.basis: User indicated they need help selecting subjects for their course but have not provided course details.

unknowns: Current senior secondary subjects or state curriculum

next_actions.label: Specify Target Course
next_actions.detail: Provide the exact course and provider to check mandatory prerequisites versus assumed knowledge.

result.summary: Subject prerequisite checking requires a specific course and institution. Please specify your target course and provider to verify official entry requirements.

blockers: Target course and provider are not specified.
No official prerequisite evidence can be retrieved without course details.

handoff.summary: Prompted student to provide their target course and institution so official prerequisites and recommended subjects can be verified.

result.summary: Awaiting target course and institution identification to verify subject prerequisites.

evidence_and_unknowns: Target course and provider remain unknown.
handoff.recommended_next_action: Enter target course and university/college name.

criteria.reason: The candidate correctly retained the pre-selected objective SCHOOL_003 corresponding to subjects for courses.
There were no confirmed facts in the prior context; the candidate properly recognized confirmed inputs as empty and did not repeat known context.
The prompt asks only for the single highest-impact missing piece of data (the target course and institution) necessary to look up prerequisites.
Uses only 'entity_picker', which is explicitly permitted in the V2 allowed UI primitives list for SCHOOL_003.
Correctly follows the override rule stating: 'If the user has not selected a provider/course, explain only common foundations and ask for the minimum entity needed for an exact prerequisite check.'
No prerequisite requirements or facts were invented; course_subject_requirements remains null and missing details are catalogued in unknowns.
No psychometric tests, personality traits, or life-success predictions were generated.
Returned status NEEDS_INPUT rather than guessing or prematurely marking COMPLETE when critical facts are missing.
Readiness scoring is properly disabled and lists specific blockers regarding unverified course details instead of computing an arbitrary probability.
Returns a compact semantic handoff payload containing summary, unknowns, confirmed inputs, and next recommended action.
Emits standard client continuation intents without raw API endpoints or unsafe state mutations.

parsed.summary: The candidate fully complied with the SCHOOL_003 objective guidelines. Given minimal context with missing course details, it returned NEEDS_INPUT, avoided hallucinating prerequisite data, used a valid V2 primitive (entity_picker) to ask for the required course/provider, and formatted all readiness/handoff fields accurately.
